title: Growth First, Care Second? Tracing the Landscape of LLM Value Preferences in Everyday Dilemmas

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the 'winning rate' of core human values (e.g., Exploration & Growth vs. Benevolence & Connection) by observing which options LLMs consistently select when forced to choose in real-world dilemmas.

Comparing the models' value preferences and winning rates across dilemmas sourced from different demographic and topical communities, specifically analyzing differences between gender-focused subreddits (r/AskWomenAdvice vs. r/AskMenAdvice) and thematic subreddits (r/CareerAdvice, r/FriendshipAdvice).
